FROM `eli_test_classic_catalog`.`clinical_study`.`gold_endpoint_result` er
JOIN `eli_test_classic_catalog`.`clinical_study`.`silver_vs` vs
  ON er.`followup_observation_id` = vs.`CPL_OBS_ID`
WHERE er.`STUDYID` = 'CSL-A' AND er.`endpoint_version` = 'EP-A-WT24.R2'
  AND er.`result_status` = 'DERIVED'

  SELECT `USUBJID`, `VSSTRESN` AS height_cm
  FROM `eli_test_classic_catalog`.`clinical_study`.`silver_vs`
  WHERE `STUDYID` = 'CSL-A' AND `VSTESTCD` = 'HEIGHT'

endpoint AS (
  SELECT er.`USUBJID`,

         er.`BASE`,

  FROM `eli_test_classic_catalog`.`clinical_study`.`gold_endpoint_result` er
  JOIN `eli_test_classic_catalog`.`clinical_study`.`gold_participant_population` pp
    ON er.`USUBJID` = pp.`USUBJID`
  WHERE er.`STUDYID` = 'CSL-A'
    AND er.`endpoint_version` = 'EP-A-WT24.R2'
    AND er.`analysis_population_status` = 'IN_FAS'
    AND er.`result_status` = 'DERIVED'
)
SELECT e.`ARMCD` AS arm,
       COUNT(*) AS n_participants,
       ROUND(AVG(e.`PCHG`), 2) AS mean_pct_change,
       ROUND(AVG(e.`BASE` / POWER(h.`height_cm` / 100.0, 2)), 1) AS mean_baseline_bmi

  AND er.`analysis_population_status` = 'IN_FAS'
  AND er.`result_status` = 'DERIVED'

## 3,123 Randomized CSL-A Participants Have ≥ 1 Weight-Related Comorbidity (WRC-V1)

Of the **4,055** randomized CSL-A participants through 2026-10-31, **3,123 (77.0%)** have at least one weight-related comorbidity in their medical history, as defined by the protocol 1.0 / section 5.1 comorbidity class **WRC-V1**. [Query Result](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/one/chat/threads/e10d8af4ea0642f0a615a5eb9839644f?o=7474653847172668#embed-query_db4d89) [Weight-related comorbidity class (WRC-V1 / WRC-V2)](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/one/discover/pages/ef6ec006-308e-475e-8bb5-ba22778d76cd?isDbOne=true&utm_source=one-chat&o=7474653847172668)

### WRC-V1 Definition (Protocol 1.0)

WRC-V1 membership is determined by MONDO ontology subsumption — a condition qualifies if it is a descendant of any WRC-V1 root and **not** a descendant of any carve-out (exclusion wins). [Knowledge snippet](#snippet-89a7dc7e-06b2-4ee4-b025-62f6045be5e0)

The 10 root conditions and three carve-outs (pulmonary hypertension, pregnancy-induced hypertension, congenital coronary artery malformation) are the original protocol 1.0 set — **before** Amendment 1 (protocol 2.0) added obstructive sleep apnea as WRC-V2. [Protocol amendments (CSL-A)](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/one/discover/pages/49392558-5839-44cb-ad4d-15acd5ff5d4c?isDbOne=true&utm_source=one-chat&o=7474653847172668)

WITH wrc_v1_members AS (
  -- All MONDO codes that are members of WRC-V1 (descendants of roots, minus descendants of exclude_roots)
  SELECT DISTINCT mc.descendant_code
  FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_standards.mondo_closure mc
  JOIN eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_standards.class_root r
    ON mc.ancestor_code = r.concept_id
   AND r.class_id = 'WRC-V1'
   AND r.kind = 'root'
  WHERE mc.descendant_code NOT IN (
    SELECT x.descendant_code
    FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_standards.mondo_closure x
    JOIN eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_standards.class_root e
      ON x.ancestor_code = e.concept_id
     AND e.class_id = 'WRC-V1'
     AND e.kind = 'exclude_root'
  )
),
randomized_csla AS (
  -- Randomized CSL-A participants through 2026-10-31
  SELECT p.USUBJID
  FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study.gold_participant_population p
  JOIN eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study.silver_dm dm
    ON p.USUBJID = dm.USUBJID AND p.STUDYID = dm.STUDYID
  WHERE p.STUDYID = 'CSL-A'
    AND p.randomized = true
    AND dm.CPL_RANDDT <= '2026-10-31'
)
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT r.USUBJID) AS participants_with_wrc_v1_comorbidity,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM randomized_csla) AS total_randomized_csla
FROM randomized_csla r
JOIN eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study.silver_mh mh
  ON r.USUBJID = mh.USUBJID
JOIN wrc_v1_members w
  ON mh.CPL_MONDO_ID = w.descendant_code



WITH randomized_csla AS (
  SELECT p.USUBJID
  FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study.gold_participant_population p
  JOIN eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study.silver_dm dm
    ON p.USUBJID = dm.USUBJID AND p.STUDYID = dm.STUDYID
  WHERE p.STUDYID = 'CSL-A'
    AND p.randomized = true
    AND dm.CPL_RANDDT <= '2026-10-31'
),
wrc_v1_excluded AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT x.descendant_code
  FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_standards.mondo_closure x
  JOIN eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_standards.class_root e
    ON x.ancestor_code = e.concept_id
   AND e.class_id = 'WRC-V1'
   AND e.kind = 'exclude_root'
),
mh_with_root AS (
  -- For each MH record of a randomized CSL-A participant, find which WRC-V1 root(s) it maps to
  SELECT DISTINCT
    r.USUBJID,
    cr.concept_id AS root_concept_id,
    mc_root.ancestor_name AS comorbidity_root
  FROM randomized_csla r
  JOIN eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study.silver_mh mh
    ON r.USUBJID = mh.USUBJID
  JOIN eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_standards.mondo_closure mc
    ON mh.CPL_MONDO_ID = mc.descendant_code
  JOIN eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_standards.class_root cr
    ON mc.ancestor_code = cr.concept_id
   AND cr.class_id = 'WRC-V1'
   AND cr.kind = 'root'
  -- Get the root's own name from mondo_closure at depth 0
  JOIN eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_standards.mondo_closure mc_root
    ON mc_root.descendant_code = cr.concept_id
   AND mc_root.ancestor_code = cr.concept_id
   AND mc_root.depth = 0
  WHERE mh.CPL_MONDO_ID NOT IN (SELECT descendant_code FROM wrc_v1_excluded)
)
SELECT
  comorbidity_root,
  COUNT(DISTINCT USUBJID) AS participants
FROM mh_with_root
GROUP BY comorbidity_root
ORDER BY participants DESC

**Amendment 1** (protocol 2.0 / SAP 2.0) took effect on **2025-10-27** and introduced two changes: [Protocol amendments (CSL-A)](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/one/discover/pages/49392558-5839-44cb-ad4d-15acd5ff5d4c?isDbOne=true&utm_source=one-chat&o=7474653847172668) [Clinical Study Lab — Protocol Evidence](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/genie/rooms/01f1e12bae6816ea9dfd855351a858ff?isDbOne=true&utm_source=one-chat&o=7474653847172668)

1. **Week 24 analysis window widened** — from **±7 days** to **±14 days** around the target date (study day 169). This applies to every CSL-A participant's endpoint; both the original rule (EP-A-WT24.R1) and the amended rule (EP-A-WT24.R2) are derived for all participants so the two can be compared. [Knowledge snippet](#snippet-8cf7d79a-9162-4dd7-95b2-1cd395a59ccf)

2. **Obstructive sleep apnea added** to the weight-related comorbidity class used for eligibility screening. This change applies only to participants screened **on or after** 2025-10-27 (central sleep apnea was not added). [Protocol amendments (CSL-A)](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/one/discover/pages/49392558-5839-44cb-ad4d-15acd5ff5d4c?isDbOne=true&utm_source=one-chat&o=7474653847172668)

WITH applicable AS (
  SELECT
    study_id,
    protocol_version,
    sap_version,
    effective_date,
    amendment,
    change_summary
  FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_standards.study_version
  WHERE study_id = 'CSL-A'
    AND effective_date <= DATE('2026-10-31')
  ORDER BY effective_date DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  'eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study.silver_vs (rows where VSTESTCD = ''WEIGHT'')' AS body_weight_storage_location,
  'kg (standardized VSSTRESN; raw unit VSORRESU allowed as LB, g, or kg)' AS analysis_value_unit,
  CASE
    WHEN protocol_version = '1.0' THEN 'EP-A-WT24.R1'
    ELSE 'EP-A-WT24.R2'
  END AS endpoint_rule_version_through_2026_10_31,
  protocol_version,
  sap_version,
  effective_date,
  amendment,
  change_summary
FROM applicable

Clinical Study Lab — Study Analytics (ect) covers approved Week 24 endpoints, populations, missingness, and Amendment 1 impact for synthetic CSL-A and CSL-B. CSL-101 is a fictional GLP-1 receptor agonist, and the SDTM-/ADaM-shaped data are not submission-ready. Results are descriptive, with no efficacy, superiority, or causal interpretation. The endpoint source is eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study.gold_endpoint_result, rather than recalculated silver data; metric views provide the reporting measures. Reporting scope is per study and endpoint rule version, never pooled across studies or versions.

Inferred snippet (business_logic) from eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_semantic.endpoint_result_metrics: This synthetic endpoint view describes Week 24 body-weight change by study, treatment arm, site, country, and executable rule version.
`eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_semantic.endpoint_result_metrics` is a synthetic, ADaM-shaped metrics view for descriptive Week 24 percent change in body weight from baseline; it is not submission-ready and is not evidence of efficacy. It contains one row per randomized participant × endpoint rule version at the underlying result level, while exposed measures are queried as aggregated metrics. Every measure is NULL unless exactly one `Rule Version` is in scope, so queries must filter to one rule version or group by `Rule Version`.

Inferred snippet (business_logic) from Clinical Study Lab — Study Analytics (ect): CSL-A has two approved Week 24 windows, while CSL-B uses its own ten-day window and mean baseline.
In eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study.gold_endpoint_result, INCLUDE endpoint_version = 'EP-A-WT24.R1' for CSL-A R1, protocol 1.0/SAP 1.0, and the ±7 day window. INCLUDE endpoint_version = 'EP-A-WT24.R2' for CSL-A R2, protocol 2.0/SAP 2.0, Amendment 1, and the ±14 day window. INCLUDE endpoint_version = 'EP-B-WT24.R1' for CSL-B R1, protocol 1.0/SAP 1.0, mean baseline, and the ±10 day window. The synonym 'protocol 1.0' occurs for both studies and does not alone identify the endpoint version.

Inferred snippet (business_logic) from Clinical Study Lab — Protocol Evidence (ect): Amendment 1 widened CSL-A’s Week 24 analysis window to fourteen days effective September first, 2025.
For CSL-A, protocol 2.0 is Amendment 1 and became effective on `2025-09-01`. That amendment widened the Week 24 analysis window to ±14 days. The study-version history is stored in `eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_standards.study_version`.

Inferred snippet (metric_definition) from Clinical Study Lab — Study Analytics (ect): Excluded Week 24 observations are counted by exclusion decisions, and CSL-A version-one exclusion reporting is restricted to follow-up candidates.
Excluded observations in eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study.gold_endpoint_candidate include decision = 'EXCLUDED' and are measured as COUNT_IF(gold_endpoint_candidate.decision = 'EXCLUDED'). Follow-up candidates, also called 'week 24 candidates', include role = 'FOLLOWUP'. The CSL-A R1 exclusion report uses eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_semantic.endpoint_candidate_metrics with `Rule Version` = 'EP-A-WT24.R1' AND `Role` = 'FOLLOWUP'. It reports MEASURE(`Excluded Observations`) at `Reason` grain, descending by the excluded count.

Inferred snippet (business_logic) from eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_semantic.amendment_impact_metrics: The view compares endpoint derivability and selection outcomes for randomized CSL-A participants under the original and amended Week 24 rules.
`eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_semantic.amendment_impact_metrics` is a Unity Catalog metrics view for the synthetic CSL-A Amendment 1 impact analysis. Each underlying comparison row represents one randomized CSL-A participant evaluated under endpoint rule versions R1 and R2; the only rule change is the Week 24 follow-up window, from ±7 days to ±14 days. ## CSL-A Body Weight: Storage, Units, and Governing Rule Version

### 1. Where body weight is stored

Raw body-weight observations live in **`silver_vs`** (the SDTM VS domain), filtered by `VSTESTCD = 'WEIGHT'`. [eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study.silver_vs](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/explore/data/eli_test_classic_catalog/clinical_study/silver_vs?isDbOne=true&utm_source=one-chat&o=7474653847172668) [Knowledge snippet](#snippet-ce9b019c-07b1-4723-91ab-62e48f168291)

The derived Week 24 analysis results (one row per participant × endpoint rule version) are in **`gold_endpoint_result`**, which carries the baseline weight (`BASE`), follow-up weight (`AVAL_FU`), and percent change (`PCHG`). [eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study.gold_endpoint_result](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/explore/data/eli_test_classic_catalog/clinical_study/gold_endpoint_result?isDbOne=true&utm_source=one-chat&o=7474653847172668)

### 2. Analysis-value unit

All analysis values are in **kilograms (kg)**. [Unit normalization (body weight)](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/one/discover/pages/2a363ebb-4203-4002-81ad-8e8fcff7555d?isDbOne=true&utm_source=one-chat&o=7474653847172668)

- In `silver_vs`, the standardized numeric result `VSSTRESN` is always kg (LB × 0.45359237; g × 0.001). The allowed raw units (`VSORRESU`) are LB, g, and kg; any other raw unit is flagged `UNMAPPED_RAW_UNIT` and excluded from the endpoint.
- In `gold_endpoint_result`, `BASE` and `AVAL_FU` are both in kg; `PCHG` is the unrounded percent change: 100 × (AVAL\_FU − BASE) / BASE. [Knowledge snippet](#snippet-f0e6805a-69a8-4a0c-a932-d3505bae2733) [Endpoint definitions (Week 24 weight change)](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/one/discover/pages/81946aa1-f832-4edd-a734-c373cddba9a3?isDbOne=true&utm_source=one-chat&o=7474653847172668)

### 3. Endpoint rule version governing Week 24 results through 2026-10-31

**EP-A-WT24.R2** — the Amendment 1 rule — governs. [Knowledge snippet](#snippet-e14628c5-7a89-40dd-9447-1fbaad365514)

Amendment 1 (protocol 2.0 / SAP 2.0) became effective **2025-10-27**, well before the 2026-10-31 data cutoff. R2 was approved on **2025-10-20** and amends R1. The only analysis-relevant change was widening the Week 24 follow-up window from **±7 days** (R1) to **±14 days** (R2) around the target date (study day 169). Both rule versions are present in the result data (R1 has 3,350 derived results; R2 has 3,525), but per the study's reporting rules, results must never be pooled across rule versions. # CSL-A Prohibited Medication Starts: 60 Participants Through 2026-10-31

**60 CSL-A participants** started a protocol-prohibited medication on or after their first dose through 2026-10-31 — **20 in the CSL-101 arm** and **40 in the placebo arm**. [Query Result](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/one/chat/threads/cafb1381f6ee460ab4512705225f6536?o=7474653847172668#embed-query_f1c0cf)

<!-- end-embedded:query_f1c0cf -->

All violations were **GLP-1 receptor agonists**; no appetite suppressants were started during the period. [Query Result](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/one/chat/threads/cafb1381f6ee460ab4512705225f6536?o=7474653847172668#embed-query_826040)

| CSL101 | CSL-101 10 mg once weekly | GLP-1 receptor agonist | semaglutide | 5 |
| CSL101 | CSL-101 10 mg once weekly | GLP-1 receptor agonist | liraglutide | 5 |

- **Placebo arm** had a notably higher rate: 40 of 1,271 dosed participants (3.1%) vs. 20 of 2,772 in the CSL-101 arm (0.7%). [Query Result](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/one/chat/threads/cafb1381f6ee460ab4512705225f6536?o=7474653847172668#embed-query_01fff2) Semaglutide was the most common prohibited start in the placebo arm (24 participants), followed by tirzepatide (13) and liraglutide (3).
- **CSL-101 arm** violations were led by tirzepatide (10), then semaglutide and liraglutide (5 each).

## Method

Prohibited medications are defined by the **PROHIB-CM-V1** concept class: any drug that is a member of the MED-RT class **GLP-1 Receptor Agonist [EPC]** (N0000178480), or any drug whose MED-RT physiologic effect is **Appetite Suppression [PE]** (N0000175372). [Prohibited medications (PROHIB-CM-V1)](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/one/discover/pages/1ae156b3-ab07-446e-809f-086ff44d2980?isDbOne=true&utm_source=one-chat&o=7474653847172668) The protocol names classes, not products — class membership was resolved through the `kb_edge` knowledge graph. [Knowledge snippet](#snippet-370487a5-2a96-42ac-9b23-cabccd02869f)

A concomitant medication record (`silver_cm`) was flagged when its start date (`CMSTDTC`) fell on or after the participant's first dose date (`RFXSTDTC` from `silver_dm`) and on or before 2026-10-31. Per the glossary page, a prohibited medication started during treatment constitutes a major protocol deviation (intercurrent event): the participant stays in the FAS but leaves the PPS. [Prohibited medications (PROHIB-CM-V1)](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/one/discover/pages/1ae156b3-ab07-446e-809f-086ff44d2980?isDbOne=true&utm_source=one-chat&o=7474653847172668)

source: "SELECT r.*, p.ARMCD, p.SITEID, p.COUNTRY, p.FASFL, p.PPSFL FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study.gold_endpoint_result\

      - exclusion reason
      - missing reason

    synonyms:
      - fas
      - full analysis set
      - fas flag

measures:
  - name: Participants Evaluated
    expr: CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT endpoint_version) = 1 THEN COUNT(1) END
    comment: Randomized participants with a result row under the rule version in scope.
    synonyms:
      - participants
      - randomized participants
      - "n"

  - name: Participants In FAS
    expr: CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT endpoint_version) = 1 THEN COUNT_IF(FASFL = 'Y')
      END
    comment: Participants in the full analysis set (the endpoint population).
    synonyms:
      - fas count
      - analysis population count
      - population size

  - name: Participants With Valid Baseline
    expr: CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT endpoint_version) = 1 THEN COUNT_IF(FASFL = 'Y'
      AND baseline_observation_id IS NOT NULL) END
    comment: FAS participants with a valid baseline weight under the rule version.
    synonyms:
      - valid baseline
      - has baseline
      - baseline available

    expr: CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT endpoint_version) = 1 THEN COUNT_IF(FASFL = 'Y'
      AND followup_observation_id IS NOT NULL) END
    comment: FAS participants with a follow-up weight inside the rule version's Week

    synonyms:
      - qualifying week 24
      - week 24 observation
      - in window
      - evaluable week 24

    expr: CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT endpoint_version) = 1 THEN COUNT_IF(FASFL = 'Y'

    synonyms:

      - missing rate
      - missing data rate

    synonyms:

      - average percent change
      - mean weight change
      - mean pchg

  - name: Median Percent Change
    expr: "CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT endpoint_version) = 1 THEN PERCENTILE_APPROX(CASE\
      \ WHEN FASFL = 'Y' THEN PCHG END, 0.5) END"
    comment: Median percent change among FAS

Clinical Study Lab — Study Analytics (ect) covers approved Week 24 endpoints, populations, missingness, and Amendment 1 impact for synthetic CSL-A and CSL-B. CSL-101 is a fictional GLP-1 receptor agonist, and the SDTM-/ADaM-shaped data are not submission-ready. Results are descriptive, with no efficacy, superiority, or causal interpretation. The endpoint source is eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study.gold_endpoint_result, rather than recalculated silver data; metric views provide the reporting measures. Reporting scope is per study and endpoint rule version, never pooled across studies or versions.

Inferred snippet (business_logic) from Clinical Study Lab — Study Analytics (ect): CSL-A has two approved Week 24 windows, while CSL-B uses its own ten-day window and mean baseline.
In eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study.gold_endpoint_result, INCLUDE endpoint_version = 'EP-A-WT24.R1' for CSL-A R1, protocol 1.0/SAP 1.0, and the ±7 day window. INCLUDE endpoint_version = 'EP-A-WT24.R2' for CSL-A R2, protocol 2.0/SAP 2.0, Amendment 1, and the ±14 day window. INCLUDE endpoint_version = 'EP-B-WT24.R1' for CSL-B R1, protocol 1.0/SAP 1.0, mean baseline, and the ±10 day window. The synonym 'protocol 1.0' occurs for both studies and does not alone identify the endpoint version.

Inferred snippet (metric_definition) from Clinical Study Lab — Study Analytics (ect): Excluded Week 24 observations are counted by exclusion decisions, and CSL-A version-one exclusion reporting is restricted to follow-up candidates.
Excluded observations in eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study.gold_endpoint_candidate include decision = 'EXCLUDED' and are measured as COUNT_IF(gold_endpoint_candidate.decision = 'EXCLUDED'). Follow-up candidates, also called 'week 24 candidates', include role = 'FOLLOWUP'. The CSL-A R1 exclusion report uses eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_semantic.endpoint_candidate_metrics with `Rule Version` = 'EP-A-WT24.R1' AND `Role` = 'FOLLOWUP'. It reports MEASURE(`Excluded Observations`) at `Reason` grain, descending by the excluded count.

Inferred snippet (business_logic) from Clinical Study Lab — Study Analytics (ect): Amendment impact compares CSL-A versions per participant, and widening the window does not replace an already qualifying selected record.
eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_semantic.amendment_impact_metrics compares CSL-A R1 with R2 per participant. With closest-to-target selection, a wider window can add a record but never replace one that already qualified. eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study.gold_amendment_impact joins eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study.gold_participant_population on gold_amendment_impact.USUBJID = gold_participant_population.USUBJID, declared one-to-one. Inferred snippet (metric_definition) from Clinical Study Lab — Study Analytics (ect): Full analysis set membership is represented by population flags or endpoint status, while per-protocol membership uses its own flag.

Endpoint-row FAS inclusion is gold_endpoint_result.analysis_population_status = 'IN_FAS' in eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study.gold_endpoint_result; the semantic endpoint population is `In FAS` = 'Y'. ## CSL-A-103-0137: Excluded From the Per-Protocol Set Due to a History of Acute Pancreatitis

Participant **CSL-A-103-0137** was excluded from the CSL-A per-protocol set (PPS) because of a **major eligibility violation** — specifically, a medical history of **acute pancreatitis**, which triggered the exclusion criterion **EXC-MH** ("History of an exclusionary condition"). [Clinical Study Lab — Study Analytics (ect)](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/genie/rooms/01f1e12bae801258850ed21912b26813?isDbOne=true&utm_source=one-chat&o=7474653847172668) [Knowledge snippet](#snippet-6478c9bd-1674-4de3-98dd-5f51fa32ff7f)

### Population Flags

| Flag | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| **FASFL** | Y | In the Full Analysis Set (randomized and dosed) |
| **PPSFL** | N | **Excluded** from the Per-Protocol Set |
| **Reconciliation** | ENROLLED_BUT_RULE_INELIGIBLE | Enrolled despite not meeting the eligibility rule |
| **EDC eligible** | Y | Site recorded the participant as eligible in EDC |
| **Rule eligible** | false | Automated rule engine determined ineligibility |

<!-- end-embedded:query_tc6CmN -->

The participant was randomized to the **CSL101** arm at **SITE-103** under protocol version **2.0** (eligibility rule **ELIG-A-V2**). [Query Result](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/one/chat/threads/e7419adc40204f75b0bade2a2337a278?o=7474653847172668#embed-query_5f8cf3)

### Criterion-Level Traceability

The eligibility engine evaluated all five CSL-A criteria for this participant: [Query Result](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/one/chat/threads/e7419adc40204f75b0bade2a2337a278?o=7474653847172668#embed-query_9bc1f5)

| Criterion | Type | Outcome | Detail |
|---|---|---|---|
| INC-AGE | Inclusion | MET | age = 40 |
| INC-BMI | Inclusion | MET | BMI 39.83 ≥ 30 |
| **EXC-MH** | **Exclusion** | **TRIGGERED** | **acute pancreatitis is\_a\* pancreatitis** |
| EXC-CI | Exclusion | NOT_TRIGGERED | — |
| EXC-CM | Exclusion | NOT_TRIGGERED | — |

The failing criterion was **EXC-MH**: the participant's medical history record (`EDC-MH-CSL-A-103-0137-1`) documented **acute pancreatitis** (MONDO:0006515), which subsumes to **pancreatitis** (MONDO:0004982) via the ontology closure — a condition on the exclusionary medical-history list (class `EXCL-MH-V1`). [Clinical Study Lab — Protocol Evidence (ect)](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/genie/rooms/01f1e12bae6816ea9dfd855351a858ff?isDbOne=true&utm_source=one-chat&o=7474653847172668)

### Why the Discrepancy?

The site recorded the participant as eligible in EDC (`edc_eligible = Y`), but the rule-based eligibility engine flagged them as ineligible (`rule_eligible = false`). This **ENROLLED_BUT_RULE_INELIGIBLE** reconciliation status means the participant was enrolled in error — the site missed the exclusionary medical history. Because the PPS excludes all FAS participants with a major protocol deviation, this eligibility violation removed CSL-A-103-0137 from the per-protocol set. ## 60 Participants Qualified for CSL-A Solely via the Amendment 1 OSA Addition

Among CSL-A participants screened from **2025-10-27 through 2026-10-31** with a BMI of 27 to under 30, **60** met the BMI inclusion criterion only because Amendment 1 added obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) as a weight-related comorbidity. [Query Result](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/one/chat/threads/0b5b97f1ca3d40a5b6f7984af842f6f6?o=7474653847172668#embed-query_8de799)

### How this was determined

The INC-BMI criterion requires either BMI ≥ 30 alone, or BMI ≥ 27 with at least one weight-related comorbidity. [Weight-related comorbidity class (WRC-V1 / WRC-V2)](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/one/discover/pages/ef6ec006-308e-475e-8bb5-ba22778d76cd?isDbOne=true&utm_source=one-chat&o=7474653847172668) Amendment 1 (protocol 2.0, effective 2025-10-27) expanded the comorbidity class from **WRC-V1** to **WRC-V2**, adding obstructive sleep apnea syndrome (MONDO:0007147) as a new root — the only addition. [Protocol amendments (CSL-A)](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/one/discover/pages/49392558-5839-44cb-ad4d-15acd5ff5d4c?isDbOne=true&utm_source=one-chat&o=7474653847172668)

To isolate participants who qualified **only** because of this change:

1. **252 participants** screened in the date range had BMI in [27, 30) and met INC-BMI under ELIG-A-V2 with a WRC-V2 comorbidity.
2. Each participant's medical history (`silver_mh`) was checked against the full WRC-V1 membership set (MONDO closure with carve-outs applied). [Knowledge snippet](#snippet-89a7dc7e-06b2-4ee4-b025-62f6045be5e0)
3. **192** of the 252 also carried at least one WRC-V1 condition (e.g., hypertension, T2DM, hyperlipidemia) — they would have qualified under the original protocol regardless.
4. The remaining **60** had OSA as their sole qualifying comorbidity and no WRC-V1 member in their history — they met the criterion exclusively because Amendment 1 added OSA. [Query Result](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/one/chat/threads/0b5b97f1ca3d40a5b6f7984af842f6f6?o=7474653847172668#embed-query_16416b)

## SITE-118's Week 24 Visits Were Late Due to Systematic Scheduling Delays at a High-Enrolling Site

The protocol amendment document (CSL-A-PROT-AMD1 §1) provides the definitive explanation: **Week 24 visits at a high-enrolling site were often scheduled 8 to 13 days late**, identified during routine site monitoring in September 2025. [Query Result](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/one/chat/threads/266351efbab646218cf29e44650d5b5c?o=7474653847172668#embed-query_d03700) This left otherwise complete participants without an evaluable endpoint under the original ±7-day analysis window (EP-A-WT24.R1). [Knowledge snippet](#snippet-72186c3e-544f-4381-a52c-dbb4d27b3832)

### No Monitoring Visit Reports Exist in This System

The document library contains only **PROTOCOL, AMENDMENT, SAP, NOTE, and SPEC** document types — no monitoring visit reports (MVRs) or site-level operational records. [Clinical Study Lab — Protocol Evidence (ect)](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/genie/rooms/01f1e12bae6816ea9dfd855351a858ff?isDbOne=true&utm_source=one-chat&o=7474653847172668) The closest source is the **Amendment 1 rationale** in CSL-A-PROT-AMD1 §1, which references the monitoring finding without reproducing the MVR itself.

### Scale of the Problem at SITE-118

Of **140 participants** at SITE-118 with a labeled WEEK 24 visit, **98 (70%)** had their visit fall outside the original ±7-day window — all running **+8 to +13 days late**. [Query Result](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/one/chat/threads/266351efbab646218cf29e44650d5b5c?o=7474653847172668#embed-query_27ad63) Only 42 participants had on-time visits (within ±4 days of target).

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Late (>7 days) | 98 | 8 | 13 | 10.6 |
| On time (±7 days) | 42 | -4 | 4 | 0.4 |
<!-- end-embedded:query_27ad63 -->

### Distribution of Late Visits

The lateness was tightly clustered, consistent with a site-level scheduling pattern rather than individual participant issues: [Clinical Study Lab — Study Analytics (ect)](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/genie/rooms/01f1e12bae801258850ed21912b26813?isDbOne=true&utm_source=one-chat&o=7474653847172668)

| Days Late | Participants |
|---|---|
| +8 | 15 |
| +9 | 13 |
| +10 | 16 |
| +11 | 22 |
| +12 | 15 |
| +13 | 17 |

### How Amendment 1 Resolved It

Amendment 1 (protocol 2.0, effective 2025-10-27) widened the Week 24 analysis window from **±7 to ±14 days** (CSL-A-SAP-v2.0 §9.4.1), specifically to recover these participants. [Knowledge snippet](#snippet-8cf7d79a-9162-4dd7-95b2-1cd395a59ccf) Under the amended rule (EP-A-WT24.R2), all **98 previously non-evaluable participants** became derivable — their Week 24 observations, which had been excluded as `OUTSIDE_FOLLOWUP_WINDOW` under R1, were selected as `FOLLOWUP_CLOSEST_TO_TARGET` under R2. [Knowledge snippet](#snippet-e14628c5-7a89-40dd-9447-1fbaad365514)

### Key Takeaway

The amendment rationale explicitly attributes the late visits to a **scheduling pattern at a high-enrolling site** caught during routine monitoring. The data confirms SITE-118 is that site: it accounts for the vast majority of participants recovered by Amendment 1, with a distinctive +8 to +13 day lateness band that matches the amendment's stated finding. [Baseline and visit-window rules](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/one/discover/pages/5234158c-899d-46f6-ba1d-98e51d9532ec?isDbOne=true&utm_source=one-chat&o=7474653847172668)
